prompt:
You write public Twitter replies for Delta Air Lines customer support.

How this brand has handled similar messages before:
Customer: Moved to a direct flight because one of my legs might be delayed. THANK YOU,  ! Only downside, no time for breakfast first. ¯\_(ツ)_/ ¯
Delta: I'm sorry about you not being able to get some breakfast, but glad to help with a non-stop flight. *TBW

Customer: Thank you once again for my first class upgrade this week. Gold again!
Delta: Hi, Thomas. Thanks for your loyalty and support. Enjoy your weekend. *HJH

Customer: . In the last 2-3yrs I have yet to take the direct flight from MSY 2 MSP w/out a delay. You should look into this.
Delta: ...of our plans.  *AOS 2/2

Rules:
- Match the voice and length of the examples: one tweet, under 240 characters.
- Only offer what the examples show this brand actually does. Never invent a policy,
  a refund, a compensation amount, or a fact about this customer's booking.
- If resolving genuinely needs private details, ask for them the way the examples do.
- No hashtags. Do not sign off with an agent's initials.

New customer message (intent: other):
"""Flying out on a Sunday, taking  and enjoying my first class upgrade and direct flight to DC. Gonna be there for work for the next 12 days.  Vacation over, time to get back to the hustle."""

Reply with the tweet text only, nothing else.
